basic_info.description: Exceptional Investment Opportunity in Prime Marina/Lombard Locale!  Charming Edwardian-era duplex built in 1912, offering classic character with modern potential.   The building features 2 light & spacious flats, a full garage (3+ car parking), ample storage area, +additional living space expansion potential on the ground level w/ access to a private outdoor patio/yard. The upper 3BR/1BA flat is currently VACANT, along with the garage, allowing immediate rental income or customization. The lower 2+BR/1BA flat has a commercial lease tenant. Located close to the popular restaurants and shops on nearby Chestnut St., Moscone Playground, Safeway, Ft. Mason, fitness studios,  public transit, tech shuttles, and more! Don't miss this rare owner-user/savvy investor opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
